map.CIE76 色差 ΔE = √((ΔL)² + (Δa)² + (Δb)²)，其: CIE76 color difference ΔE = √((ΔL)² + (Δa)² + (Δb)²), where ΔL is lightness difference, Δa and Δb are chroma differences; ΔE maps roughly to gray scale: ΔE 0.8 → grade 5, 1.7 → 4-5, 2.5 → 3-4, 3.4 → 3, 5.0 → 2, 7.5 → 1-2; ΔE ≤1.0 is barely perceptible, ≤3.0 acceptable, >5.0 clearly visible.

map.注：本工具采用 CIE76 色差公式估算，仅供参考，正式评级应以标准灰度卡目视对: Note: this tool estimates with the CIE76 color difference formula for reference only; formal grading should use the standard gray scale by visual comparison.
map.水洗、摩擦、光照后对比原样与测试样颜色，估算变色牢度等级: After washing, rubbing or light exposure, compare original and tested samples to estimate color-change grade

map.客诉褪色时复测并出具色差数据作为赔付依据: On fading complaints, re-measure and provide ΔE data as a basis for compensation
map.原色 RGB(51,102,204)、水洗后 RGB(60,108,210) →: Original RGB(51,102,204), after wash RGB(60,108,210) → ΔE = √(9²+6²+6²) ≈ 11.9 → color-change grade about 3-4 (good, slightly low).
map.ΔE < 1 近乎无变色（5 级）；1–3（4–5 级）；3–6（3–4 级）；: ΔE <1 nearly no change (grade 5); 1-3 (4-5); 3-6 (3-4); 6-12 (2-3); >12 (1-2, obvious fading).
map.色差 ΔE 和灰度卡等级怎么对应？: How does ΔE map to gray-scale grade?
map.ΔE 越小等级越高；一般 ΔE≤1 为 5 级、≤3 为 4 级、≤6 为 3: Smaller ΔE means higher grade; generally ΔE≤1 is grade 5, ≤3 grade 4, ≤6 grade 3; refer to GB/T 250 gray scale.
map.人眼和仪器结果差很多怎么办？: What if visual and instrument results differ a lot?
map.以标准光源箱下灰度卡目评为基准，仪器 ΔE 作辅助；注意光源（D65）与背景中性: Baseline is gray-scale visual grading under a standard light box; instrument ΔE is auxiliary; mind the light source (D65) and neutral-gray background.
